name: Raumarik
lore: Raumarik: the frozen north, where the winter never ends. Hati, the wolf that hunts the moon - Fenrir's son - waits in his howe in the west for the moon to run close enough to catch; when he catches it, the long winter comes for all of Midgard. His host holds the north - the fenrir soldiers and their mystics, the winterwolves, the wraiths and wights - and King Eirik's Host means to take it back.

chains.title: The Icestriders
chains.hint: Frost is spreading across the northern waste...

stages.name: Clear Icestrider Camp
stages.objective: Clear the icestrider camp
stages.announce: The icestriders are weaving a frost to bury the passes. Break their camp.
stages.success: You have cleared the icestrider camp. Icestrider Hrimfaxi comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the icestrider camp. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Icestrider Hrimfaxi
stages.objective: Defeat Icestrider Hrimfaxi
stages.announce: Icestrider Hrimfaxi stands at the icestrider camp. Bring friends.
stages.success: Icestrider Hrimfaxi falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Icestrider Hrimfaxi slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Icestrider Chillers Hold the Road
stages.objective: Drive the icestrider chillers off the road
stages.announce: With The Icestriders lost, the icestrider chillers have spread down onto the road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The icestrider chillers are gone from the road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Sten, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Sten has come out to set the road right. The icestrider chillers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The icestrider chillers break and scatter. The road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Sten falls, and the icestrider chillers take the road back.

chains.title: Wights of the White Waste
chains.hint: The wind carries voices across the waste...

stages.name: Protect Skald Arnbjorn
stages.objective: Protect Skald Arnbjorn, who is singing the death-song over the cairn
stages.announce: Skald Arnbjorn is singing the death-song that keeps the wights in their cairns. They have come to silence him.
stages.success: "That's done," says Skald Arnbjorn. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Skald Arnbjorn falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Skald's Cairn
stages.objective: Clear the skald's cairn
stages.announce: They came from the skald's cairn. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the skald's cairn. Frore Lich Vetrarr comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the skald's cairn. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Frore Lich Vetrarr
stages.objective: Defeat Frore Lich Vetrarr
stages.announce: Frore Lich Vetrarr stands at the skald's cairn. Bring friends.
stages.success: Frore Lich Vetrarr falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Frore Lich Vetrarr slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Windswept Wraiths Hold the Road
stages.objective: Drive the windswept wraiths off the road
stages.announce: With Wights of the White Waste lost, the windswept wraiths have spread down onto the road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The windswept wraiths are gone from the road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Hild, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Hild has come out to set the road right. The windswept wraiths are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The windswept wraiths break and scatter. The road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Hild falls, and the windswept wraiths take the road back.

chains.title: The Frost-Bound Bears
chains.hint: Bears and winterwolves hunt together on the ice...

stages.name: Clear Frozen Den
stages.objective: Clear the frozen den
stages.announce: Ironpelt and the frost-bound bears hunt with the winterwolves now, and nothing on the ice is safe. Break their den.
stages.success: You have cleared the frozen den. Ironpelt comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the frozen den. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Ironpelt
stages.objective: Defeat Ironpelt
stages.announce: Ironpelt stands at the frozen den. Bring friends.
stages.success: Ironpelt falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Ironpelt slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Frost Bound Bears Hold the Old Road
stages.objective: Drive the frost bound bears off the old road
stages.announce: With The Frost-Bound Bears lost, the frost bound bears have spread down onto the old road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The frost bound bears are gone from the old road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Sten, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Sten has come out to set the old road right. The frost bound bears are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the old road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The frost bound bears break and scatter. The old road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Sten falls, and the frost bound bears take the road back.

chains.title: The King's March on the Icestrider Fells
chains.hint: The Banner-Huscarl is forming the King's Host up for the Icestrider Fells.

giver.name: Banner-Huscarl Thorvid
giver.greet: The Icestrider Fells, north-east. Hati's soldiers hold a post up there with the icestriders round them. Six at least, and say [forward].
giver.reply: Up the fells! Break their post - then their mystic!
giver.busy: Not yet. The host is still forming up - rest, and gather.
giver.thanks: The King's Host holds the Icestrider Fells - and the next thirty minutes are ours.
giver.regret: Back to the camp! We'll go again.

stages.name: Break the Fells
stages.objective: Break Hati's post on the Icestrider Fells
stages.announce: The King's Host is on the Icestrider Fells! Break the post!
stages.success: The post breaks.
stages.fail: The host is thrown back.

stages.name: Frost-Mystic Hrimgerd
stages.objective: Defeat Frost-Mystic Hrimgerd
stages.announce: Frost-Mystic Hrimgerd, ice in her braids, a wolf's skull on her staff: 'The fells are the first thing he'll see when he catches her. He'll want them clean.'
stages.success: Hrimgerd falls in the snow. The fells are the King's.
stages.fail: The host is driven back.

chains.title: The King's March on the Wraith Moor
chains.hint: Huscarl Thorvid is forming the King's Host up for the Wraith Moor.

giver.name: Huscarl Thorvid
giver.greet: The Wraith Moor. The dead of the endless winter walk there, and Hati's soldiers have three frost-stones up to keep them walking. Six at least, and say [forward].
giver.reply: Onto the moor! Hold the three frost-stones, then find the lich!
giver.busy: Not yet. The host is still forming up - rest, and gather.
giver.thanks: The King's Host holds the Wraith Moor.
giver.regret: Back off the moor! We'll go again.

stages.name: Break the Wraith Moor
stages.objective: Break Hati's post on the Wraith Moor
stages.announce: The King's Host is on the Wraith Moor! Break the post!
stages.success: The post breaks.
stages.fail: The host is thrown back.

stages.name: The Frost-Stones
stages.objective: Hold the three frost-stones at once while the seithkona break them
stages.announce: Three frost-stones keep the winter's dead walking - stand at all three at once while the seithkona break them!
stages.success: Done - on to whoever holds the place!
stages.fail: It's lost - the host falls back.

stages.name: the Frore Lich
stages.objective: Defeat the Frore Lich
stages.announce: The Frore Lich, a dead jarl in a crown of ice: 'I froze at the first winter. I'll see the last.'
stages.success: The lich cracks like river-ice, and the moor's dead lie down.
stages.fail: The host is driven back.

chains.title: The King's March on the Winterwolf Run
chains.hint: Shield-Maiden Sigrun is forming the King's Host up for the Winterwolf Run.

giver.name: Shield-Maiden Sigrun
giver.greet: The Winterwolf Run. The packs run there for Hati, and we take it and we hold it - the King's banner goes up, and they'll come for it. Six at least, and say [forward].
giver.reply: Into the run! Break them, then hold the banner!
giver.busy: Not yet. The host is still forming up - rest, and gather.
giver.thanks: The King's Host holds the Winterwolf Run.

stages.name: Break the Winterwolf Run
stages.objective: Break the packs on the Winterwolf Run
stages.announce: The King's Host is in the Winterwolf Run! Break the packs!
stages.success: The post breaks.
stages.fail: The host is thrown back.

stages.name: The King's Banner
stages.objective: Keep Seithkona Alfrun alive while the banner goes up
stages.announce: Seithkona Alfrun is raising the King's banner on the run - and the packs are coming for it!
stages.thanks: "It's up. Let him see it from his howe."
stages.success: They break - and whoever leads them comes out.
stages.fail: The banner falls.

stages.name: the Pack-Mother of the Run
stages.objective: Defeat the Pack-Mother of the Run
stages.announce: The Pack-Mother, a winterwolf as big as a horse, her muzzle grey with frost: 'My cubs run for Hati. So will yours.'
stages.success: The Pack-Mother falls, and every wolf on the run howls once and scatters.
stages.fail: The host is driven back.

chains.title: The King's March on the Fenrir Camp
chains.hint: Huscarl-Marshal Hallvard's own sword-bearer is forming the King's Host up for the Fenrir Camp.

giver.name: Sword-Bearer Grim
giver.greet: The Fenrir Camp. Hati's own soldiers - the greater fenrir - and the last thing between us and the howe. Eight at least, and say [forward].
giver.reply: Into the camp! Break the totems, then their jarl!
giver.busy: Not yet. The host is still forming up - rest, and gather.
giver.thanks: The King's Host holds the Fenrir Camp - the howe is in sight.
giver.regret: Out of the camp! We'll go again.

stages.name: Break the Fenrir Camp
stages.objective: Break Hati's soldiers in the Fenrir Camp
stages.announce: The King's Host is in the Fenrir Camp! Break the soldiers!
stages.success: The post breaks.
stages.fail: The host is thrown back.

stages.name: The Wolf-Totems
stages.objective: Stand at the three wolf-totems at once while the huscarls bring them down
stages.announce: Three wolf-totems call the camp's courage from Hati himself - stand at all three at once and the huscarls will fell them!
stages.success: Done - on to whoever holds the place!
stages.fail: It's lost - the host falls back.

stages.name: Fenrir-Jarl Vargeisl
stages.objective: Defeat Fenrir-Jarl Vargeisl
stages.announce: Fenrir-Jarl Vargeisl, more wolf than man, in mail of frozen iron: 'Hati is my lord's lord's son. You'll not reach him over me.'
stages.success: Vargeisl falls, and the camp breaks. Through the snow to the west: Hati's Howe.
stages.fail: The host is driven back.

chains.title: Hati's Host Strikes Back at the Icestrider Fells
chains.hint: Hati's host is coming back for the Icestrider Fells!

stages.name: Hold the Icestrider Fells
stages.objective: Keep the host's captain alive at the Icestrider Fells
stages.announce: Hati's host is coming back for the Icestrider Fells! The host will hold as long as it can - help them, or it falls!
stages.thanks: They broke on us. The line holds.
stages.success: Hati's host breaks against the line. The Icestrider Fells holds - and the clock starts again.
stages.fail: The banner falls. Hati's host has the Icestrider Fells again.

chains.title: Hati's Host Strikes Back at the Wraith Moor
chains.hint: Hati's host is coming back for the Wraith Moor!

stages.name: Hold the Wraith Moor
stages.objective: Keep the host's captain alive at the Wraith Moor
stages.announce: Hati's host is coming back for the Wraith Moor! The host will hold as long as it can - help them, or it falls!
stages.thanks: They broke on us. The line holds.
stages.success: Hati's host breaks against the line. The Wraith Moor holds - and the clock starts again.
stages.fail: The banner falls. Hati's host has the Wraith Moor again.

chains.title: Hati's Host Strikes Back at the Winterwolf Run
chains.hint: Hati's host is coming back for the Winterwolf Run!

stages.name: Hold the Winterwolf Run
stages.objective: Keep the host's captain alive at the Winterwolf Run
stages.announce: Hati's host is coming back for the Winterwolf Run! The host will hold as long as it can - help them, or it falls!
stages.thanks: They broke on us. The line holds.
stages.success: Hati's host breaks against the line. The Winterwolf Run holds - and the clock starts again.
stages.fail: The banner falls. Hati's host has the Winterwolf Run again.

chains.title: Hati's Host Strikes Back at the Fenrir Camp
chains.hint: Hati's host is coming back for the Fenrir Camp!

stages.name: Hold the Fenrir Camp
stages.objective: Keep the host's captain alive at the Fenrir Camp
stages.announce: Hati's host is coming back for the Fenrir Camp! The host will hold as long as it can - help them, or it falls!
stages.thanks: They broke on us. The line holds.
stages.success: Hati's host breaks against the line. The Fenrir Camp holds - and the clock starts again.
stages.fail: The banner falls. Hati's host has the Fenrir Camp again.

chains.title: Hati's Howe
chains.hint: Huscarl-Marshal Hallvard himself is gathering the King's Host before Hati's Howe.

giver.name: Huscarl-Marshal Hallvard
giver.greet: Hati's Howe. He's in there, watching the moon - and his brother Skoll will come when he calls, and the winter with him. Two groups at least - ten, bots and all - and healers, and curers. Then say [for the King].
giver.reply: For the King! Healers to the back - and whatever comes out of the north, hold!
giver.busy: Not yet. The host is still forming up - rest, and gather.
giver.thanks: Hati is broken. The moon runs free tonight.
giver.regret: Back! Back to the camp! We'll come again.

stages.name: Hati, Who Hunts the Moon
stages.objective: Defeat Hati, Who Hunts the Moon
stages.announce: Hati comes out of his howe - a wolf the size of a longship, frost pouring off him, his eyes on the moon and then on you: 'She runs closer every night. You can't stop that. You can only be in my way.'
stages.success: Hati falls in the snow before his howe with a howl that shakes the mountains - and is gone, into the north, his hide torn and his brother with him. Overhead, the moon runs on. Across Raumarik the winter mist begins to lift.
stages.fail: Hati drives the King's Host from his howe.
